name: verdant-site
description: Verdant design system, demoed as a static site built to score well on the W3C Web Sustainability Guidelines. Styled with PandaCSS.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && panda cssgen -m --lightningcss -o dist/styles.css && node scripts/finalize.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:worker && npm run test:browser
scripts.verify:ci: npm run build && npm run check:budgets && npm run test
